title: Amazon fights Delivery Protection Act by putting stickers on its packages
gist: Amazon is lobbying against New York City's Delivery Protection Act (Intro 518), which would force companies with last-mile facilities to directly employ delivery contractors, using unprecedented package stickers, a homepage banner and in-app pop-ups. Amazon threatens to consider moving operations out of NYC; Mayor Zohran Mamdani and the Teamsters support the bill.

themes.theme: NYC Delivery Protection Act and labor-cost risk

insights.so_what: Direct-employment mandates would raise last-mile labor costs and undermine Amazon's contractor-based delivery model.
